name: Dryad Archer
description: A dryad archer is a small plant creature that has been awakened by some sort of magic. These skilled marksmen can usually be found in forests, blending seamlessly with the natural environment, their appearances reflecting the seasons and foliage around them. While intelligent and adept with a bow, dryad archers are often timid and serve their masters without much complaint.

actions.name: Whip
actions.description: The dryad uses one of it's vines to whip a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Vine Trap
actions.description: In response to a creature moving to an adjacent tile, the dryad extends its vines in an attempt to ensnare the intruder by making an athletics check with a 1d4 bonus against an acrobatics or athletics check. On a success, the creature has a movement speed of 0 until the end of their turn.

actions.name: Bowshot
actions.description: The dryad archer fires their bow at a creature, dealing physical damage.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: When standing still, the dryad appears to be a plant and gains a 1d6 bonus to their initial stealth check when using the Hide action.
